memory_candidates.content: orchestrator-postflight.sh's header comment describes a shared research/plan/implement postflight pipeline, but a repo-wide grep shows it is called only from skill-implementer/SKILL.md (the plain /implement command). skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md never calls it, in either single-task or multi-task mode -- confirmed independently by an existing comment in context/patterns/batch-orchestration-guardrails.md's own reference table. /orchestrate's real single-task postflight path is orchestrate-stage5-postflight.sh (called from Stage 5's 'Shared postflight tail'), and its multi-task path is Stage MT-4 -- both converge on skill_postflight_update/skill_link_artifacts in skill-base.sh. Before editing orchestrator-postflight.sh to change /orchestrate behavior, verify via grep that the target file is actually in /orchestrate's call graph -- task descriptions that name it for an /orchestrate-affecting change may be wrong.

skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md's single-task, non-team-mode Agent dispatch context tables (Stage 4 state handlers) never include an artifact_number field -- that field is only threaded through the Stage 3.6 Team Fan-Out context shape. general-research-agent.md documents reading artifact_number 'from delegation context' with no described fallback, so a non-team /orchestrate research dispatch has no documented way to learn its round number today.
